Coastal Guardian: Restoration Command

Full Campaign Edition • Beginner → Expert • Prepared by Joseph Johnston III
Full Campaign — Educational Outreach Edition • v2.15.1 Full Campaign Edition Prepared by Joseph Johnston III. Version v2.15.1 Full Campaign Edition, dated October 1, 2026. This self-contained browser game includes Student and Teacher modes, the four-stage campaign progression, budget and labor constraints, restoration project design, dynamic map changes, random events, monitoring, and end-of-stage reporting. Cost values, ecological scores, and success probabilities are simplified gameplay estimates and should be reviewed by subject-matter experts before formal educational or planning use.
Louisiana coastal restoration strategy game

Build land, protect communities, and defend biodiversity without breaking the budget.

Plan restoration projects on an illustrated Louisiana coast. Design each project, manage your budget and work crews, respond to storms and other surprises, and watch the coast change as your projects are completed.

Prepared by Joseph Johnston III.

Version: v2.15.1 Full Campaign Edition Date: October 1, 2026 Values: educational estimates
FULL CAMPAIGN PROGRESSION

Build from introductory restoration decisions to basin-scale mega projects.

Student mode progresses through all four stages. Teacher Sandbox can jump directly to any stage for demonstrations or free-play exploration.

Find this game and other versions
1 • BeginnerFragmented marsh recoveryMarsh creation, planting, nutria management, monitoring
2 • IntermediateWorking coastShoreline, fisheries, access, hydrology, home elevations
3 • AdvancedBasin integrationBarrier/headland, ridge, beneficial use, sequencing
4 • ExpertMega projectsDiversions, barrier systems, regional home elevations, multi-basin tradeoffs

1 Mission Setup

Set the difficulty before you start. These settings scale every campaign stage: stage grants, labor capacity, stage length, acreage goals, and how often surprise events hit.

Choose the Custom preset to set one stage-gate passing score for the mission.
2 Choose a mode and start

Student Full Campaign

Configurable budget, labor cap, timeline, randomized events, and a final score based on acres restored, biodiversity, protection, industry impact, and efficiency.

  • Budget can vary by scenario
  • Labor cap can be adjusted
  • Goals and event pressure can change each run

Teacher Sandbox / Free Play

Unlimited budget, event trigger controls, discussion prompts, and the ability to demonstrate how different management choices affect outcomes.

  • Unlimited funds
  • Trigger storms, oil spills, grants, and policy shifts
  • Pause-and-explain prompts
